sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```python name=advanced/hashing_security.py
# ============================================================
# HASHING — One-way transformation of data
# ============================================================
import hashlib
import hmac
import secrets

# --- Hashing ---
text = "Hello, World!"
md5 = hashlib.md5(text.encode()).hexdigest()
sha256 = hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()
sha512 = hashlib.sha512(text.encode()).hexdigest()

print(f"MD5:    {md5}")     # 65a8e27d8879283831b664bd8b7f0ad4
print(f"SHA256: {sha256}")  # dffd6021bb2bd5b0af676290809ec3a53191dd81...

# --- Hash large file in chunks ---
def hash_file(filepath: str, algorithm: str = "sha256") -> str:
    h = hashlib.new(algorithm)
    with open(filepath, "rb") as f:
        while chunk := f.read(8192):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

# --- Password Hashing (NEVER use plain MD5/SHA for passwords!) ---
import hashlib

def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
    """Use PBKDF2 with salt for password hashing."""
    salt = secrets.token_hex(16)
    key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
        "sha256",
        password.encode(),
        salt.encode(),
        iterations=100_000,
    )
    return f"{salt}:{key.hex()}"

def verify_password(password: str, stored: str) -> bool:
    salt, key_hex = stored.split(":")
    key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac(
        "sha256",
        password.encode(),
        salt.encode(),
        iterations=100_000,
    )
    return key.hex() == key_hex

stored = hash_password("my_secret_password")
print(verify_password("my_secret_password", stored))  # True
print(verify_password("wrong_password", stored))       # False

# --- HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) ---
secret_key = b"my-secret-key"
message = b"Important message"
signature = hmac.new(secret_key, message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

# Verify (use compare_digest to prevent timing attacks!)
received_sig = signature
is_valid = hmac.compare_digest(
    signature,
    hmac.new(secret_key, message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
)

# ============================================================
# SECRETS — Secure Random Numbers
# ============================================================
# NEVER use `random` for security! Always use `secrets`.

# Generate tokens
token_hex = secrets.token_hex(32)        # 64-char hex string
token_url = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)    # URL-safe base64 string
token_bytes = secrets.token_bytes(32)    # Raw bytes

# Secure random integer
pin = secrets.randbelow(10000)           # 0000-9999

# Secure random choice
password_chars = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789!@#$%"
password = "".join(secrets.choice(password_chars) for _ in range(16))

# Secure comparison (constant-time to prevent timing attacks)
secrets.compare_digest("token_a", "token_b")

# --- Generate secure API key ---
def generate_api_key(prefix: str = "sk") -> str:
    return f"{prefix}_{secrets.token_urlsafe(32)}"

print(generate_api_key())  # sk_aB3x...
```
